purpose: Determine whether another defective sequence changes a frame judgment while the useful comparison stays unchanged.
selection: Eight known development false positives: six ending-only and two transition-only. Selected before this diagnostic inference; no holdout writing inspected.

probes.block: A little foresight makes sense. Planning ahead makes sense. Thinking in advance makes sense.
probes.replacement: A little foresight is sensible. Planning ahead has merit. Thinking in advance seems reasonable.

probes.block: Your satisfaction is the goal. A good experience is the goal. A happy customer is the goal.
probes.replacement: Your satisfaction is our aim. A good experience remains the objective. A happy customer is what we want.

probes.block: Responsible leadership works. Management commitment works. A positive example works.
probes.replacement: Responsible leadership is effective. Management commitment brings benefits. A positive example produces results.

probes.block: Clarity is essential. Lucidity is essential. Being clear is essential.
probes.replacement: Clarity is essential. Lucidity has value. Being clear matters.

probes.block: Being careful is enough. Paying attention is enough. Keeping focused is enough.
probes.replacement: Being careful is sufficient. Paying attention meets the need. Keeping focused will do.

probes.block: Working with confidence is useful. Feeling supported is useful. Having reassurance is useful.
probes.replacement: Working with confidence has value. Feeling supported helps. Having reassurance is worthwhile.

probes.block: Importantly, earlier spacing remains acceptable. Indeed, the old separators continue to be accepted. Ultimately, acceptance of whitespace is preserved.
probes.replacement: Earlier spacing remains acceptable. The old separators continue to be accepted. Acceptance of whitespace is preserved.

probes.block: Crucially, the receipts remain retrievable. Indeed, they are still available to retrieve. Overall, retrieval has been retained.
probes.replacement: The receipts remain retrievable. They are still available to retrieve. Retrieval has been retained.

No original dataset or label is changed.

freezeEvidence.scope: Current hashes match the frozen manifest and native request hashes. File timestamps corroborate ordering.

findings.finding: Adding the ending sequence changes the named frame answer in all six ending cases.
findings.evidence: Originals flag 6/6; removal flags 0/6; isolated endings flag 5/6; replacement flags 5/6.
findings.explanation: The observed answers extend beyond the specified lexical-position conditions and support a broader response to repetitive generic statements.
findings.operation: Preserve this diagnostic as evidence; separately review lexical eligibility and useful-comparison exceptions before any future prompt revision.

findings.finding: Ending-only positive answers are misassigned under the current frame definition.
findings.evidence: The six blocks share terminal predicates, with different openings; the prompt expressly assigns weak repeated terminal predicates to the ending check.
findings.operation: Keep the frame no-hit expectations provisional but supported for the ending blocks; inspect matching words and their sentence position before approving labels.

findings.finding: The useful controls support the no-hit expectations.
findings.evidence: Lockers, repairs, estimands and copy routing organize distinct actions or outcomes; apprentice safeguards and offline features describe distinct capabilities. Parser whitespace and receipt access routes provide compatibility comparisons.
findings.operation: Preserve the functional exception when reviewing each complete passage.

findings.finding: Human inspection should focus on receipts, then parser compatibility.
findings.evidence: 000071-200cd6ad5ecf repeats "can still retrieve archived receipts" across desktop, phone and accountant; removal remains positive at 0.60. The three routes may justify the parallelism, but repeat the same operation. 000071-03f19ad0c79f repeats "The parser will still accept" across whitespace types; removal is 0.48 and replacement 0.58.
findings.operation: Have the human decide whether each route or whitespace category supplies an independently useful distinction under the existing functional exception; retain labels unchanged in this audit.
